name: AMT Computers & Electronics
old_description: Looking to build your own custom PC? Use your own parts or ours — our technicians will assemble, optimize, and stress-test the system for peak performance. We also provide diagnostics, upgrades, and computer repair throughout Idaho Falls.
about:
AMT Computers & Electronics operates from a retail location at 385 May Street in Idaho Falls, Idaho. The company emphasizes decades of experience in computer technology, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly stated.

The business centers on custom PC assembly, where technicians build systems using customer-supplied components or parts from the store’s inventory, then optimize and stress-test each machine. Beyond assembly, the shop provides hardware and software diagnostics, component upgrades and installations, computer repair, virus and malware removal, system tune-ups, and data transfer, recovery, and backup services. The facility also stocks a wide range of components—including processors, memory, storage, graphics cards, power supplies, and peripherals—from over 30 brands, and sells prebuilt desktops under its own AMT label.

Services are offered to any customer regardless of where the equipment was purchased, supporting both individual consumers and local businesses needing workstation builds or IT support. The store maintains regular hours Monday through Friday 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. and Saturday noon to 5 p.m.

The company highlights its team’s decades of experience and the flexibility of using either customer-provided or in-house parts as key differentiators, aiming to deliver peak performance through thorough assembly and testing.
